english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for hostile entry into a country, territory, organization, or system.

examples.english: The enemy army may invade our country.
examples.jyutping: dik6 gwan1 ho2 nang4 jap6 cam1 ngo5 gwok3

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for gaining unauthorized access to a computer system, website, network, or account.
Use this when someone gains unauthorized access to a computer system or network.

examples.english: They used a program to hack into the company website and even changed the homepage.
examples.traditional: 佢哋用程式入侵咗公司個網站，仲改埋首頁。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 jung6 cing4 sik1 jap6 cam1 zo2 gung1 si1 go3 mong5 zaam6 zung6 goi2 maai4 sau2 jip6

examples.english: The hackers successfully compromise the company’s network, causing data to leak.
examples.traditional: 黑客成功入侵公司個網絡，搞到資料外洩。
examples.jyutping: hak1 haak3 sing4 gung1 jap6 cam1 gung1 si1 go3 mong5 lok6 gaau2 dou3 zi1 liu2 ngoi6 sit3
